No hiring option can be put forward from this run, because the £400k salary limit was not assessed.

- All four options were analysed as having **no stated effect on annual salary spend**, so the comparison cannot test the key budget condition.
- The recorded constraint, **annual salary spend < £400k/year**, is not aligned to the model’s salary measure: it currently represents a modelled change rather than a total annual salary level.
- The comparison is fragile and rests entirely on Olumi-authored estimates, including delivery capacity and onboarding load; none has been validated by you.

The next useful step is to define total annual salary spend for each staffing option, including the current team.
